cards.front: Adolescent safety plans should include both trusted adults AND [___] as contacts, because young people are more likely to disclose distress to them than to professionals.
cards.context:
Adolescents are developmentally more likely to disclose distress to peers than to adults or professionals.

No-suicide contracts are not evidence-based and have been replaced by structured safety planning.

cards.front: ICD-11 replaced categorical personality disorder subtypes with a [___] severity model (mild, moderate, severe) plus optional trait qualifiers.
cards.context:
It also reduces extensive comorbidity between categorical PD diagnoses.

DSM-5-TR retains categorical subtypes but includes a similar dimensional Alternative Model in Section III.

cards.front: The three phases of trauma treatment are: 1) safety and [___], 2) trauma processing, 3) reintegration/reconnection.
cards.context: The phase-based model (Herman, 1992) recognises that trauma processing cannot occur safely without first establishing psychological stability.

cards.front: The most important element of a CL psychiatry referral is a specific [___] the psychiatrist can answer.
cards.context: A vague referral like '?psych review' leads to inefficient assessments and poorly targeted advice.

cards.front: Anxious-ambivalent attachment is characterised by intense separation distress and [___] behaviour on reunion (simultaneously seeking and resisting comfort).
cards.context: This develops from inconsistent caregiving where the parent is sometimes responsive, sometimes unavailable.
